title: Game Development
description: Build real games you can play, in Python. One game per level, playable from your very first line of code.

prerequisite.note: You'll need variables, if/else, loops, functions and lists, which is Python Modules 1 to 5.

modules.title: Scene Builder
modules.tagline: Get your first picture on the screen, and learn how the computer finds any spot on it.

modules.title: Bouncing Ball
modules.tagline: Make something move, and meet the game loop that powers every game ever made.

modules.title: Catch the Fruit
modules.tagline: Take control with the arrow keys, catch falling fruit, and keep score.

modules.title: Space Dodger
modules.tagline: Dodge a whole asteroid field using lists, so you get many enemies from just a few lines.

modules.title: Jump Quest
modules.tagline: Gravity, jumping and platforms. Build a real little platformer.

modules.title: Juice It
modules.tagline: Squash, stretch, sparks and screen shake. The polish that makes a game feel great.

modules.title: Levels & Menus
modules.tagline: Start screens, game over, and levels drawn on a grid.

modules.title: Your Own Game
modules.tagline: Pick an idea, build it start to finish, and share it with a friend.
